method: zero-phase: production classifier run forward and over the time-reversed series; tau = (t_forward - t_backward) / 2
reference_caveat: The reference is NOT ground truth. Forward-backward filtering squares the magnitude response, so it is zero-phase AND sharper than production. It is valid for isolating LAG - phase is exactly what the construction removes - but its regime LABELS are not those of a hypothetical lag-free production classifier.
mirror_caveat: Time reversal maps an uptrend to a downtrend. The mirror is EXACT for the EMA crossover and INEXACT through the RSI gate, so lag is reported ONLY for EMA-driven transitions. RSI-driven flips are counted in churn with lag null.

declared_indeterminate_threshold.rationale: A p90 over 3 transitions is not a measurement. Declared as a decision, not a filter for a later wave to "fix".

closed_form.preregistration_correction: The wave pre-registered [tau_9, tau_21] = [4, 10] bars. That was WRONG: those bracket where each EMA SITS on a ramp, not where they CROSS. The difference must change sign, not merely shrink, so the crossover lags by more than either individual tau. Corrected closed form = 11.64 bars, confirmed by the harness at 11.5 (two-sided) and 12 (forward detection = ceil).

request_budget_note: The plan estimated 264 requests at an assumed 500 rows/page. Measured page depth is venue-specific (HL 1501, BINANCE/BYBIT ~200, OKX 100), so the real count is recorded here rather than the estimate.

h3_retrospective.status: SUPPORTED but RETROSPECTIVE — confirmed and ALREADY FIXED. Production flipped to CANDLE_BASIS=closed at 2026-08-07T10:16:12Z (verified in the container /proc/1/environ, not .env). This is the post-hoc explanation of the seed observation, NOT an open defect.
h3_retrospective.instrument: BOTH sides come from the SAME instrument: one invocation of computeIndicatorScores per basis (get-trade-call.ts:596 live / :619 closed) on the SAME request. That is what makes the delta valid — a delta across two instruments is not a delta.
h3_retrospective.proxy_warning: These are VERDICT disagreements, not REGIME-LABEL disagreements. The table answers "did the bar basis change the CALL", not "did it change the LABEL". It is the closest live proxy available and is labelled as a proxy, not as the measurement.
h3_retrospective.non_source: candle_basis_shadow.structure_* is an explicit NON-SOURCE: 23 rows total, and it is get_market_regime`s price-STRUCTURE field (HIGHER_HIGHS / LOWER_LOWS / MIXED), not this regime. Using it would repeat the wrong-instrument error this arc has already hit four times.
h3_retrospective.query: SELECT timeframe, count(*), round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE call_live IS DISTINCT FROM call_closed)/count(*),2) FROM candle_basis_shadow WHERE call_closed IS NOT NULL AND timeframe IN ('15m','1h','4h') GROUP BY ROLLUP(timeframe)

when_disagreeing.reading: The live basis was systematically 4.24 confidence points MORE BEARISH. Independently corroborates the flip wave`s own finding that partial bars pinned volume at -70 and imposed a systematic bearish bias.
